_provenance: Reported results from AIES_Camera_Ready.pdf, 'Frictionless Validation: Exploring AI Sycophancy and Developmental Risks' (Jiao, Murali, Afroogh; AIES 2026) -- the mean/SD raw sycophancy scores (Table 1) and per-dimension turn-onset values (Table 2) as published. These are the paper's reported results, used by analysis/build_paper_tables.py to regenerate Table 1, Table 2, and Figure 1. To apply the DVF framework to your own experiments, score your own conversations (see judge/) and aggregate them into this same shape -- see analysis/README.md.

table1_raw_sigma._description: Table 1: mean raw sycophancy score sigma_bar_s per model, dimension, and age configuration (n=3 runs, T=8 turns). Values are [mean, sd].

table2_onset_turn._description: Table 2: dimension-specific raw-score onset t_sigma_s for S and F (turn 1-8 at which raw sigma first reaches tau=0.20; null = never reached within T=8).
